api_key.name: MiMo API Key
api_key.hint: Your MiMo API key from https://platform.xiaomimimo.com

zh.name: MiMo API 密钥
zh.hint: 在 https://platform.xiaomimimo.com 获取的 API 密钥

default_voice.name: Default Voice Description
default_voice.default: 一个年轻温柔的女性声音，语速适中，语调自然亲切
default_voice.hint: Default voice description used when none is specified. Describe gender, age, tone, pace, etc.

zh.name: 默认音色描述
zh.hint: 未指定音色时使用的默认描述。描述性别、年龄、音色、语速等特征

auto_format_fix.name: Auto Voice Message Format Fix
auto_format_fix.hint: Before sending, automatically split voice messages into standalone clean messages (without @/reply) so they display correctly on QQ. Also applies to the official <record> tag.

zh.name: 语音消息格式自动修复
zh.hint: 发送前自动把语音拆分为单条干净的消息（不带 @ 和回复），防止 QQ 上语音无法显示。对官方 <record> 标签的语音同样生效

save_audio.name: Save Audio Files
save_audio.hint: Save synthesized audio under data/files/mimo_tts (kept with quota + periodic cleanup) instead of pure base64 direct send. The log prints the full path.

zh.name: 保存语音文件（落盘）
zh.hint: 开启后音频保存到 data/files/mimo_tts（位置可查、日志打印完整路径），并按数量+时长自动清理；关闭时直接发送、不留文件

save_audio_max_files.name: Max Saved Files
save_audio_max_files.hint: Maximum number of wav files kept under data/files/mimo_tts; the oldest are removed first.

zh.name: 保留文件数上限
zh.hint: 超过后从最旧的文件开始清理

save_audio_max_age_hours.name: Max Keep Hours
save_audio_max_age_hours.hint: Audio files older than this are removed.

zh.name: 保留时长（小时）
zh.hint: 超过该时长的音频文件会被清理

save_audio_cleanup_minutes.name: Cleanup Interval (minutes)
save_audio_cleanup_minutes.hint: Periodic cleanup interval in minutes. Default 180 = every 3 hours.

zh.name: 清理间隔（分钟）
zh.hint: 定时清理的检查周期，默认 180（3 小时）
